title: Shared primitives
description: Units and primitives shared by every schema in this folder. Metres, seconds, degrees. Right-handed, Y up, X east, Z north. Ground points are [x, z]; 3D points are [x, y, z]. Headings: 0 = +z (north), clockwise positive seen from above (Unity eulerAngles.y), heading = atan2(dx, dz).

Vec3.description: 3D point [x, y, z] in metres, Y up. Maps to Unity Vector3(x, y, z) directly.

XZ.description: Ground point as an object {x, z} (brain / sim protocol style).

Pose.description: Stop pose written by envgen (load_point, dump_point, parking slot).

TruckId.description: Truck id. Current worlds and the brain use truck-N (N from 0). Legacy Marble worlds (marble_pit, marble_draft_test) still carry T1..T5.

ExcavatorId.description: Excavator id, exc-N (N from 0), one per ore face.

Id.description: Site / junction / road id: lowercase snake_case (e.g. ore_1, crusher, j_1, ramp_1).
